candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Japanese text, readings and indices all match the image; full-width spaces after index numbers are fine. Glosses are accurate but terse and stylistically inconsistent (some with 'to', some without). 文章 as 'sentence; writing' is acceptable but 'text' would be better. No gloss errors.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the Japanese terms, readings, indices and headers identically and correctly, so the ranking rests on gloss accuracy and consistency. C has the most precise and consistent glosses. A is nearly as good, with one noun-first gloss for a verb. E is accurate but inconsistent in style. D glosses the verb 自由化する only with nouns. B is last because its gloss for 生まれ育つ omits the 'born' sense, on top of the same noun-first gloss as A.
